column1: # The accent run's pairs for the KDE facts (the specification's S17, "The accent run"), read by
# scripts/measure_kde_accent.sh (a bare name is the installed scheme file
# /usr/share/color-schemes/<name>.colors). Four schemes, each with no accent and the two accents
# spike K used, #e5a50a (a yellow: low contrast on a light background, so the link colour is
# darkened) and #5e2ca5 (a violet: low contrast on a dark one, so it is lightened):
#   BreezeLight, BreezeDark: the preset's own scheme files (a Colors:Header group with an
#     [Inactive] group, no tint, no accent-coloured title bar);
#   BreezeClassic: the accent-coloured title bar option (accentActiveTitlebar=true) with no
#     Colors:Header group, the one colour group the other three have and it lacks;
#   SUSECafe: a scheme that tints (TintFactor=0.15) and has the title bar option
#     (TitlebarIsAccentColored=true) and a Colors:Header group, of two keys only, so applyScheme()
#     also tints the keys that group leaves unset. A third-party file, fetched at its pin by the
# The last three pairs check that the scheme applied first leaves nothing behind: BreezeLight
# after BreezeClassic instead of BreezeDark, BreezeClassic applied to a fresh configuration with
# no scheme before it, and SUSECafe after BreezeClassic instead of BreezeDark.
